message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Daily sweep for the Products.txt list, covering credible vulnerability reports and material updates observed in the 24-hour window before the scheduled run on 2026-07-24 at 05:10 IST. Fresh, product-matched findings were identified for Google Chrome, ManageEngine ADAudit Plus, JetBrains PyCharm, and MongoDB Server. Grafana and Veeam items also surfaced in the monitored window, with timing notes included where the vendor publication date was earlier or only date-level precision was available.

**Finding 1: Google Chrome desktop security update**

- Product: Google Chrome
- Issue: CVE-2026-16807, CVE-2026-16806, CVE-2026-16805, and CVE-2026-16804
- Severity: High for all four listed CVEs.
- Description: Google released Chrome 150.0.7871.186/.187 for Windows and macOS and 150.0.7871.186 for Linux with four security fixes covering out-of-bounds write and use-after-free issues in Codecs, WebMCP, Blink, and Input.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes Google Chrome, and the advisory is the official Chrome stable desktop security update.
- Source: Google Chrome Releases, 2026-07-23: https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/07/stable-channel-update-for-desktop_01320465736.html

**Finding 2: ManageEngine ADAudit Plus unauthenticated remote code execution**

- Product: ManageEngine ADAudit Plus
- Issue: CVE-2026-6516
- Severity: Critical in Tenable/GitHub-derived reporting.
- Description: Zohocorp ManageEngine ADAudit Plus versions before 8606 are reported affected by unauthenticated remote code execution through a vulnerable agent API.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes ManageEngine, and ADAudit Plus is a ManageEngine product.
- Source: Tenable CVE entry, published 2026-07-23: https://www.tenable.com/cve/CVE-2026-6516 ; GitHub Advisory Database search also lists CVE-2026-6516 as published 2026-07-23.

**Finding 3: JetBrains PyCharm arbitrary code execution before project trust**

- Product: PyCharm
- Issue: CVE-2026-65908
- Severity: High; CVSS 8.6 in public CVE feeds.
- Description: JetBrains PyCharm before 2026.1.4 / 2026.2 is reported vulnerable to arbitrary code execution via a malicious Python executable when opening an untrusted project.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes PyCharm, and the finding names JetBrains PyCharm directly.
- Source: GitHub Advisory Database unreviewed feed and CVE feeds published 2026-07-23: https://github.com/advisories?query=type%3Aunreviewed ; Feedly JetBrains CVE listing: https://feedly.com/cve/vendors/jetbrains

**Finding 4: MongoDB Server CVE batch affecting mongod behavior**

- Product: MongoDB Server / mongod
- Issue: Multiple MongoDB Server CVEs, including CVE-2026-13064, CVE-2026-13066, CVE-2026-13070, CVE-2026-13071, CVE-2026-13072, CVE-2026-13073, CVE-2026-13074, CVE-2026-13076, and CVE-2026-13078
- Severity: Mixed. Examples include CVE-2026-13072 listed as Critical under CVSS v4 by Tenable, and several others listed as Medium or High depending on CVSS version/source.
- Description: The batch includes MongoDB Server denial-of-service, memory corruption, server-side JavaScript information disclosure, arbitrary file read, and TLS/OCSP-related crash scenarios. Several require authenticated access, write/read privileges, server-side JavaScript, or non-default compute mode; CVE-2026-13074 is described as unauthenticated remote CPU-consumption DoS.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes MongoDB, and the records explicitly name MongoDB Server / mongod. MongoDB-adjacent search terms were checked as required.
- Source: NVD example for CVE-2026-13072: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-13072 ; Tenable MongoDB CVE entries, published or updated 2026-07-22/2026-07-23: https://www.tenable.com/cve/CVE-2026-13078

**Finding 5: Grafana templates test endpoint denial of service**

- Product: Grafana
- Issue: CVE-2026-21723
- Severity: Medium, CVSS 5.3 per Grafana.
- Description: Grafana disclosed that the Alertmanager templates test endpoint can execute templates without memory limits; repeated execution can exhaust memory and crash the Grafana service. The endpoint requires low privileges and can be exposed when anonymous access is enabled.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes Grafana, and the advisory is from Grafana Labs for Grafana itself.
- Source: Grafana Labs advisory, published 2026-07-22: https://grafana.com/security/security-advisories/cve-2026-21723/
- Timing note: The vendor page shows a 2026-07-22 publication date without a time. It is included because it surfaced in current searches and falls near the 24-hour boundary; confirm exact internal cutoff if strict hour-level tracking is required.

**Finding 6: Veeam appliance updater local privilege escalation**

- Product: Veeam Backup & Replication / Veeam Software Appliance / Veeam Infrastructure Appliance
- Issue: CVE-2026-56844
- Severity: High, CVSS 8.4 per Veeam/GitHub.
- Description: Veeam reports that the Veeam Updater component can allow a local user to elevate privileges and gain root-level access on affected Veeam Software Appliance or Veeam Infrastructure Appliance systems. Windows-based Veeam Backup & Replication backup servers are not affected by this specific issue.
- Why it appears relevant: Products.txt includes Veeam, and the affected appliance components are part of the Veeam Backup & Replication 13 ecosystem.
- Source: Veeam KB4879: https://www.veeam.com/kb4879 ; GitHub Advisory Database, published 2026-07-22: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-72f6-c934-4fg9
- Timing note: Veeam's vendor KB was published 2026-07-14, while GitHub/NVD advisory visibility is dated 2026-07-22. Treat as newly surfaced rather than newly vendor-disclosed.

**Possible matches needing review**

- Microsoft Edge: Microsoft posted a 2026-07-23 Stable Channel release note, but the reviewed Edge security notes did not clearly enumerate fresh CVEs for that date. I did not include the Chrome CVEs as Edge findings without an Edge-specific advisory.
- WordPress plugins: Multiple WordPress plugin CVEs were published on 2026-07-23, but they did not clearly match the monitored Yoast SEO or Advanced Custom Fields entries. They were excluded to avoid loose WordPress ecosystem matching.

Closing note: Immediate review is recommended for ManageEngine ADAudit Plus because the issue is described as unauthenticated RCE, and for Chrome fleet patching because all four newly listed Chrome CVEs are High severity. MongoDB, PyCharm, Grafana, and Veeam items should be reviewed based on deployed versions, exposure, and whether the noted preconditions apply. No fresh, credible, clearly product-matched findings were verified for the remaining monitored products in this run.
